title: Savannah Police Officer Fired for Sharing Flock Login with ICE Agent Husband
excerpt: A Savannah police officer was fired after an investigation revealed she shared her Flock system login information with her ICE agent husband.
body_html:
A police officer in Savannah has lost her job after an internal investigation revealed she shared her system credentials with an immigration enforcement official. The officer, Amber Harpe, was dismissed in August following findings that she provided her login information for the Flock automated license plate reading system to her husband, Tyler Harpe, who works as an ICE agent.

According to the department, the Savannah Police Department does not share its Flock data with Immigration and Customs Enforcement. Officials stated that giving unauthorized access to the platform was a direct violation of internal security protocols.
